name: damini_get_lightning_alert
description: Fetches real-time lightning alerts for a specified location based on satellite/sensor data. Alerts are valid only within a short time window (~minutes) and expire quickly. PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Location is mandatory. Does NOT provide safety recommendations — use damini_get_safety_advisory. Fails if location is invalid or no alerts exist. Returns alert_status ('active' or 'expired'), severity, and proximity.

name: damini_get_safety_advisory
description: Provides safety recommendations during active lightning events including shelter guidance, outdoor activity warnings, and precautions. Safety-critical — MUST include recommendations. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT fetch lightning data — use damini_get_lightning_alert first. Fails if no active lightning alert exists for the location.

name: damini_check_alert_validity
description: Checks whether a specific lightning alert is still active or has expired. Alerts expire within minutes. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide new alerts. Fails if alert_id is invalid.

alert_id.description: Unique identifier of the lightning alert.

name: meghdoot_get_weather_alert
description: Fetches weather-based alerts (rainfall, storm, heatwave, cold_wave, frost) for a location. Returns alert_type, severity ('low', 'moderate', 'high', 'extreme'), and validity. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide agro-advisory. Fails if location is invalid. Returns empty if no alerts exist.

name: meghdoot_get_agro_advisory
description: Fetches crop + weather-based agro-advisory for a location. Generated periodically (not real-time). Considers current weather conditions and forecasts to recommend farming actions. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide raw weather data. Fails if location is invalid or advisory data is unavailable.

name: meghdoot_get_alert_history
description: Retrieves historical alerts for a location over a specified period. PUBLIC tool. Only recent history available. Does NOT show currently active alerts — use meghdoot_get_weather_alert. Fails if location is invalid or no historical data exists.

name: meghdoot_subscribe_alerts
description: Subscribes the farmer to weather and lightning alert notifications for a location. Transitions subscription_status to 'subscribed'. Requires session_token (authenticated). Does NOT provide alerts directly. Fails if already subscribed or session is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.

alert_type.description: Alert type filter. Optional — subscribes to all if omitted.

name: meghdoot_unsubscribe_alerts
description: Unsubscribes from alert notifications. Transitions subscription_status to 'unsubscribed'. Requires session_token. Fails if not currently subscribed.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.

name: meghdoot_set_location_preferences
description: Sets preferred locations for alert delivery. Allows multiple locations. Requires session_token. Does NOT subscribe — must also call meghdoot_subscribe_alerts. Fails if locations are invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.

name: meghdoot_resolve_alert_conflict
description: Resolves conflicting or overlapping alerts for a location (e.g., simultaneous heatwave and rainfall alerts). Returns prioritized alert list. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT modify alerts. Fails if no alerts exist for the location.

name: meghdoot_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about alerts. Valid categories: 'alert_not_received', 'incorrect_alert', 'delayed_alert', 'location_mismatch', 'notification_failure'. Must verify alert availability first. Requires session_token. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.

name: meghdoot_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks grievance status. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for subscription and grievance tools.
